lessons.claim: Two spec-hash functions that look interchangeable are not: bdbot.runid.spec_hash takes json.dumps' default ensure_ascii=True while simbot.io.sha256_payload passes ensure_ascii=False. Measured: identical on every ASCII payload, different on any payload with a non-ASCII key or value ({'점도': 8.51e-4} -> 6b178a2bd90d vs df013e47cf6b). In a repo with 1533 Korean strings in the spec payload this was one non-stripped field from surfacing; what holds it safe is physics_only() stripping the prose-carrying DOC_KEYS first. Left unmerged because 263 run directories are named by the bdbot one, and pinned by a test so it cannot be cleaned up. Lesson: when de-duplicating, test the pair on adversarial input before declaring them equivalent -- agreement on the typical input is not equivalence.
